name: 責任者・参加権限・通知・期間・公開範囲を持つ目標作成
prompt: Recreate only the complete Asana “Create a new goal” dialog in the primary crop. The source region is 713 × 726 px, nearly square. Keep the same compact modal geometry and full field order, with a white surface, softly rounded outer corners, fine neutral dividers, and a subtle edge shadow. Do not include the dimmed page or browser chrome. Header: bold Japanese title 「新しい目標を作成」 and a small close X at the far right. Body order: label 「目標名 *」 and one full-width field containing 「ASMobbinキャンペーンを完了する」; label 「責任者」 and one full-width owner field with the exact small circular source portrait, name alias 「山田 花子」, and a trailing remove X; label 「メンバー」 with the source circled information icon, then one full-width member field containing the original yellow 「jm」 avatar, the Japanese alias 「田中 明」, a remove X, and a right-aligned 「編集者」 dropdown with chevron. Keep the source checkbox checked in Asana blue, followed by 「新しいメンバーへ目標への参加を通知」. Next create a two-column row: left label 「対象期間」 with the source info icon and a dropdown showing 「第4四半期・2025年度」 plus the smaller muted date range 「10月1日〜12月31日」; right label 「公開範囲」 and a dropdown with the source outlined people icon and 「公開」. Under that row, add the small muted lightbulb tip and the Japanese copy 「作成後も詳細と進捗の設定を編集できます。」. A fine divider separates the footer. Put the outlined 「取消し」 button and the blue filled primary 「目標を保存」 button at the lower right. Preserve all source field boundaries, spacing, alignments, typography hierarchy and icon roles. Use the mock for Japanese labels and the owner/member aliases only; keep the source goal content, selected period, checked notification, role, public setting, colors and artwork. Do not use the mock's green accents or invent additional content. Use compact regular Meiryo-style Japanese UI text. Raster candidate only; no native editability or working behavior claim.
reviewNotes: The full goal-dialog order is preserved: localized title and goal value, owner, member with Editor role, checked new-member notification, two-column Q4 FY25 date range and Public visibility, source tip, divider and footer actions. Source colors and artwork cues are retained without the mock green. Candidate is 1254x1254 (1.00:1) versus the 713x726 (0.98:1) source crop. Avatar pixel identity, exact font metrics, native editability and live form behavior are unverified. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only.
